title: 중앙선거관리위원회 위원 수당 등에 관한 규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:2:0:00002:part:1/1
title_original: 중앙선거관리위원회 위원 수당 등에 관한 규칙
full_text: Article 2 (Scope of Application) Unless otherwise specifically provided by any other statute or regulation, matters concerning the types, recipients, and amounts of allowances and other payments to members of the National Election Commission shall be governed by these Rules. <Amended on February 6, 2024>
